name: Timothy M. Sweeney

career.title: Various senior leadership roles (joined nearly 30 years before 2022)
President (overseeing Global Risk Solutions, Global Retail Markets and Liberty Mutual Investments)
Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer

background_rationale: A career Liberty Mutual executive of roughly three decades who ran the Global Retail Markets business unit and then all three business units as President before becoming CEO.

notable.summary: Liberty Mutual agreed to sell its personal and small commercial insurance operations in Brazil, Chile, Colombia and Ecuador to Talanx for about EUR 1.38 billion, which Sweeney framed as sharpening operational focus.
Liberty Mutual agreed to sell Liberty Seguros, its personal and small commercial business in Spain, Portugal, Ireland and Northern Ireland, to Generali for EUR 2.3 billion.
Sweeney was elected Chairman of the Board on April 9, 2025, succeeding David H. Long and combining the chairman, president and CEO roles.

Liberty Mutual established a $600 million endowment for the Liberty Mutual Foundation to fund housing stability, workforce development and climate resiliency nonprofits; the same month it retired the Safeco brand.

personal_story.hook: A Lowell High School graduate, Tim Sweeney spent nearly 30 years at Liberty Mutual before becoming its 10th CEO.
personal_story.summary: Sweeney graduated from Lowell High School in Lowell, Massachusetts, and earned an economics degree and an MBA from Harvard. He built his career inside Liberty Mutual over nearly three decades, leading its Global Retail Markets personal and small commercial insurance division before being named President of the company in 2021. In January 2023 he became the 10th CEO in the insurer's 110-year history, and in April 2025 he also became chairman. Little else about his early life has been made public.
